decisions.reason: The thermoforming unit is close to the core dental equipment line, has had its own web page for two years, and represents visible, accumulated investment, so management will persist with it.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core and riskier, but the firm just launched it in 2024 with a dedicated page and its own digital-manufacturing investment, so weak early results can still be blamed on start-up effects and management will hold on for now.
The post-curing unit fits the firm's integrated digital dental workflow and was launched only recently, so although it is only mentioned on the website, it is unlikely to be dropped within a year.
